# Bid the style, the operators, and the extra work.

> Price an automatic driveway gate from single swing, dual swing, or slide: opening width, leaf material, columns, power, loops, and access — not a published $4,500 kit special. See the operators and the walk-away number.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
